source: Flight & Aerospace Academy · Ability System v4 · draft · October 30, 2026

abilities.mission: Find out whether, where and how high you may fly before you take off.
abilities.name: Airspace check
skills: Look up a location on the FAA UAS Facility Map
Explain controlled airspace and LAANC in plain words
Check for TFRs and NOTAMs
Read a METAR for wind and visibility

abilities.mission: Write a program that reads an input and controls an output.
abilities.name: Arduino basics
skills: Upload and change the blink sketch
Read a button and switch an LED
Use a variable and an if statement
Fix one bug using the serial monitor

abilities.mission: Show that you and your robot are safe to fight.
abilities.name: Arena Pass
skills: Explain the arena rules and the stop signal
Run the pre-fight inspection checklist
Prove the failsafe and weapon lock
Repair and re-inspect between matches
abilities.unlocks: The competition team: 3 lb robots (ENG 201) and outside events

abilities.mission: Leave your bench better than you found it, every class.
abilities.name: Bench reset
skills: Return every tool to its shadow board spot
Sort scraps, sweep and wipe the bench
Power down irons, chargers and printers
Report anything broken or running low

abilities.mission: Bind a transmitter to a receiver and set it up for your vehicle.
abilities.name: Bind a radio
skills: Bind with your own unique binding phrase
Create and name a model
Set channel directions and endpoints
Set and test the failsafe

abilities.mission: Build a circuit without solder and make it work.
abilities.name: Breadboard circuit
skills: Read a simple schematic
Build an LED and resistor circuit
Add a switch and explain where the current flows

abilities.mission: Turn a sketch into a part on the computer.
abilities.name: Design a CAD part
skills: Sketch the part with dimensions on paper
Model it in an Onshape Part Studio
Add a hole that fits a real screw
Export a print-ready file

abilities.mission: Find and set the balance point so the airplane flies instead of tumbling.
abilities.name: Center of gravity
skills: Mark the CG on the plan
Balance the airframe on your fingertips or a stand
Move weight to correct the CG, then check again

abilities.mission: Design and print a chassis that fits your motors, battery and electronics.
abilities.name: Chassis design
skills: Lay out every part to scale in CAD
Print it and test-fit all parts
Improve it at least once using a test
Stay under the class weight limit
abilities.unlocks: Robot car and combat robot capstones

abilities.mission: Run a Cessna 172 checklist the way real pilots do: read, do, verify.
abilities.name: Preflight and checklists
skills: Run the before-start checklist out loud
Explain why pilots use checklists even when they know them
Complete a preflight walkaround in the simulator

abilities.mission: Find a fault in a circuit with the meter instead of guessing.
abilities.name: Circuit debugging
skills: Measure voltage at three points in a circuit
Find a planted fault in under 10 minutes
Explain what you found and how you fixed it

abilities.mission: Change altitude at a set speed and level off on target.
abilities.name: Climbs and descents
skills: Climb at best rate and level off within 100 ft
Descend at a set rate
Combine a climb with a turn

abilities.mission: A fully built 1 lb combat robot that passes weight, safety and drive tests.
abilities.name: Combat robot (1 lb)
skills: Integrate the chassis, drive, power and control modules
Make weight: 1 lb (454 g) or less
Drive a figure eight and push the test block
Pass the failsafe test

abilities.mission: Make your vehicle respond to the radio and stop safely when the signal is lost.
abilities.name: Control module
skills: Map the sticks to motors or servos
Tune rates so control is smooth
Prove the failsafe stops everything
Record the setup in your logbook

abilities.mission: Fly as a two-pilot crew: pilot flying and pilot monitoring.
abilities.name: Crew coordination
skills: Brief the departure as pilot flying
Make the callouts as pilot monitoring
Swap roles mid-mission with a clear handover

abilities.mission: Make connectors that do not fall out mid-match or mid-flight.
abilities.name: Crimp and connect
skills: Strip and crimp a JST or Dupont connector
Solder an XT30 or XT60 battery connector
Pull-test every connector you make

abilities.mission: Plan and fly a simulated cross-country flight between two airports.
abilities.name: Cross-country flight
skills: Build a navigation log with headings and times
Fly the route using checkpoints
Divert to an alternate airport when asked

abilities.mission: Join the team building the academy's student CubeSat.
abilities.name: Mission 2030 team
skills: Hold two capstones
Take a role on a subsystem team
Present progress at the semester showcase
abilities.unlocks: Flight Commander, when you lead a subsystem

abilities.mission: A fully built drone that flies a timed mission course.
abilities.name: Custom drone
skills: Integrate the frame, power module and flight controller
Pass the pre-arm checklist
Fly the timed mission course
abilities.unlocks: Drone competitions and Remote Pilot Certificate Prep

abilities.mission: A first real flight with a certificated flight instructor at a partner flight school.
abilities.name: Discovery flight
skills: Do the preflight with the instructor
Fly the four fundamentals in the real airplane
Write a logbook reflection and decide whether to pursue the license

abilities.mission: Improve a part on purpose: change one thing, test it, keep what works.
abilities.name: Design, Make, Evaluate
skills: Write what you want to improve and how you will measure it
Make one change at a time
Run the same test before and after
Keep or reject the change, with a reason

abilities.mission: Build a working drivetrain: two motors, wheels and a frame that drives straight.
abilities.name: Drive module
skills: Mount motors square to the frame
Drive 3 meters straight, within 10 cm
Turn in place both ways
Fix one problem found in testing
abilities.unlocks: Robot car and combat robot capstones

abilities.mission: Handle an engine failure and other emergencies with memory items and checklists.
abilities.name: Emergency procedures
skills: Fly best glide speed and pick a landing spot
Run the engine-failure memory items
Handle an electrical failure
Declare an emergency on the radio

abilities.mission: Join parts so they stay together under vibration and still come apart for repair.
abilities.name: Fasteners and linkages
skills: Choose screw, nut and washer sizes
Use threadlocker where it belongs
Build a pushrod linkage with no slop

abilities.mission: Configure a drone flight controller so it arms, flies and stops safely.
abilities.name: Flight controller setup
skills: Flash and configure the flight controller
Set motor order and direction
Set the arming switch and failsafe
Pass the pre-arm checklist with propellers off

abilities.mission: Fly the airplane you built at a model aviation field, with the club's safety rules.
abilities.name: Field flight day
skills: Complete the field's preflight checklist
Fly 3 circuits and land on the runway
Log the flight and any repairs

abilities.mission: Use the simulators and VR headsets safely and leave the Flight Deck ready for the next crew.
abilities.name: Flight Deck clearance
skills: Start up and shut down a simulator station
Fit and clean a VR headset, and know when to stop
Follow Flight Deck rules for food, cables and seats
Report a fault in the station log

abilities.mission: Fly RC aircraft and drones safely, indoors and at the field.
abilities.name: Flight Line clearance
skills: Explain the propellers-off rule on the bench
Call clear and arm only on the flight line
Know where spectators stand and why
Land at once when the instructor calls it

abilities.mission: Cut and glue foam board into clean, strong airframe parts.
abilities.name: Foam cut and glue
skills: Cut a straight line and a bevel with a foam knife
Score, fold and glue a hinge
Reinforce a joint with tape or a spar

abilities.mission: Build a gripper that picks up and releases a test object on command.
abilities.name: Gripper module
skills: Mount a servo with no slip
Pick up the test object 5 times out of 5
Release it on a marked spot

abilities.mission: Use the hand tool wall safely: cutters, drivers, foam knives and hot glue.
abilities.name: Hand Tool clearance
skills: Cut away from your body with a foam knife
Use hot glue without burns and know the cool-down rule
Pick the right driver and bit, then put them back
Carry and pass tools safely

abilities.mission: Hold a drone steady and fly it facing any direction.
abilities.name: Hover and orientation
skills: Hover inside a box for 30 seconds
Fly a square with the nose forward
Fly with the nose pointing toward you

abilities.mission: Assist in an FLT 101 class as an Instructor Cadet.
abilities.name: Instructor Cadet
skills: Brief a maneuver to a newer student
Watch a flight and give one clear correction
Help run the debrief
abilities.unlocks: The path to Junior Instructor (depends on age and New Jersey working papers)

abilities.mission: Read the six main flight instruments and know what each one tells you.
abilities.name: Cockpit instruments
skills: Name the six instruments and what they show
Read altitude, airspeed and heading in flight
Spot a failed instrument by cross-checking

abilities.mission: Charge, store and handle lithium batteries without risk of fire.
abilities.name: LiPo clearance
skills: Check a battery for puffing or damage
Charge only in a safe bag on the right setting
Store at storage voltage in the metal box
Explain what to do if a battery smokes

abilities.mission: Record what you did, what went wrong and what you will try next, the way pilots and engineers do.
abilities.name: Logbook entry
skills: Write a dated entry: goal, what you did, result
Note one problem and how you solved it
Add a photo or sketch

abilities.mission: Measure to the millimeter so parts fit the first time.
abilities.name: Measure and mark
skills: Read digital calipers in millimeters
Mark and cut a part to a drawing within 1 mm
Check a printed part against its CAD size

abilities.mission: Use a multimeter to check voltage and continuity before you trust a battery or a wire.
abilities.name: Meter basics
skills: Set the meter to DC volts and read a battery
Check a wire or switch for continuity
Explain why you never measure current on the volts setting

abilities.mission: A fully built model rocket that launches straight and comes back under its parachute.
abilities.name: Model rocket
skills: Integrate the body, nose cone, fins and recovery system
Pass the stability and preflight check
Launch, recover and inspect it
Write the flight up as a test report

abilities.mission: Connect a motor and speed controller and control it safely.
abilities.name: Wire a motor and ESC
skills: Solder the motor wires and insulate them
Connect ESC, receiver and battery in the right order
Set direction and calibrate the throttle
Test with propellers or wheels off

abilities.mission: Design and print a nose cone and fin set, then attach them true.
abilities.name: Nose cone and fins
skills: Model a nose cone and fin can in CAD
Print and test-fit them on the body tube
Check stability: center of pressure behind center of gravity

abilities.mission: Prepare for the FAA Part 107 knowledge test.
abilities.name: Remote pilot exam prep
skills: Score 80% or better on 3 practice tests
Plan a full mission from a client request
Explain airspace, weather and the rules in a mock oral
abilities.unlocks: Readiness to sit the Part 107 knowledge test (from age 14; certificate from 16)

abilities.mission: Fly the traffic pattern and make every radio call on time.
abilities.name: Traffic pattern and radio calls
skills: Enter the pattern at 45 degrees to the downwind
Make a position call on each leg
Hold pattern altitude and spacing

abilities.mission: Help a newer student through an ability you already hold, without doing it for them. A learning role inside class, not a job.
abilities.name: Peer coach
skills: Coach one student through an ability you hold
Ask questions instead of taking the tools
Tell the instructor when they are ready for the checkride

abilities.mission: Show your work so someone who was not there understands it.
abilities.name: Photo and video a build
skills: Shoot 3 clear photos: overview, detail, in action
Record a 30-second clip explaining one part
Follow the media rules: no faces without permission

abilities.mission: Publish a page that shows colleges, mentors and employers what you built.
abilities.name: Portfolio page
skills: Pick your 3 best projects
Write a short story for each: problem, build, result
Add photos, video and test data

abilities.mission: Build a power system a capstone can trust: battery, switch, fuse and wiring.
abilities.name: Power module
skills: Choose the wire gauge for the current
Build a harness with a switch and fuse
Measure voltage under load
Pass a tug test and a visual inspection

abilities.mission: Mount a motor, ESC and propeller, then measure the thrust.
abilities.name: Power pod and thrust test
skills: Mount the motor square on the firewall
Balance and fit the propeller
Measure thrust on the test stand
Pick the propeller that gives the thrust you need

abilities.mission: Explain your project to the group at the debrief, then take questions.
abilities.name: Present your build
skills: Explain the problem, your design and one trade-off
Show what failed and how you fixed it
Answer two questions from the group
abilities.unlocks: Required for Mission Specialist and Pilot

abilities.mission: Print your own part and check that it fits.
abilities.name: 3D print a part
skills: Slice with the class settings
Watch the first layer and stop a bad start
Remove supports and clean the part
Test the fit and note what to change

abilities.mission: Keep the printers moving for the whole class.
abilities.name: Run the print queue
skills: Check a file is printable before it joins the queue
Load filament and start a print
Clear a failed print and log why it failed
Hand finished parts back, labeled

abilities.mission: Talk like a pilot: phonetic alphabet, numbers and the parts of a radio call.
abilities.name: Radio basics
skills: Say a callsign and numbers the aviation way
Make a call: who you are calling, who you are, where, what you want
Read back an instruction

abilities.mission: A fully built RC airplane that passes inspection and flies a circuit.
abilities.name: RC airplane
skills: Integrate the wing, tail, power pod and control module
Pass the preflight inspection and range check
Fly a takeoff, circuit and landing, with an instructor on the buddy box if needed
abilities.unlocks: Field flight day and RC Aerial Combat

abilities.mission: Learn stick skills on the RC simulator before you risk your airplane.
abilities.name: RC simulator flying
skills: Take off, fly a circuit and land on the simulator
Recover from an upset
Fly the circuit in both directions

abilities.mission: Get real numbers from a sensor and use them in code.
abilities.name: Read a sensor
skills: Wire a distance or line sensor
Print readings to the serial monitor
Trigger an action at a set value

abilities.mission: Pack a parachute that opens every time.
abilities.name: Recovery system
skills: Size a parachute for the rocket's weight
Pack it with wadding and a shock cord
Pass a drop test

abilities.mission: A fully built robot car that drives a course on radio control and finishes one section on its own.
abilities.name: Robot car
skills: Integrate the chassis, drive, power, control and sensor modules
Complete the course on radio control
Complete one section on its own using the sensor
Pass the instructor inspection

abilities.mission: A robotic arm that finds, picks and sorts objects on its own.
abilities.name: Robotic arm
skills: Integrate the gripper, sensor and power modules
Pick and place 5 objects in a row
Sort objects by color or size on its own
abilities.unlocks: The Robotic Arm & AI Vision showcase

abilities.mission: Know the model rocket safety code and run a launch countdown.
abilities.name: Rocket range clearance
skills: Explain the NAR Model Rocket Safety Code in your own words
Run the countdown as range safety officer
Handle motors only the way the instructor shows

abilities.mission: Find your way on an aeronautical chart.
abilities.name: Read a sectional chart
skills: Find an airport and read its information
Name the airspace around Jersey City
Measure a course and a distance

abilities.mission: Build a sensing system your robot can act on.
abilities.name: Sensor module
skills: Mount the sensor where it reads reliably
Filter noisy readings
Make the robot react on its own
abilities.unlocks: Robot car and robotic arm capstones

abilities.mission: Know the shop rules, the tools that can hurt you and what to do when something goes wrong.
abilities.name: Shop Safety clearance
skills: Walk the shop and name the hazard at each station
Wear and fit safety glasses correctly
Show where the first aid kit, fire extinguisher and exits are
Explain stop-work: when and how to call it
abilities.unlocks: The Engineering Lab and every bench ability

abilities.mission: A scored checkride in the simulator: one full flight from preflight to shutdown. Skill-building only, not logged as FAA flight time.
abilities.name: Simulator checkride
skills: Preflight, taxi and take off to standard
Fly the pattern and land
Handle one emergency the examiner gives you
Debrief your own performance
abilities.unlocks: Pilot rank, with the debrief presentation

abilities.mission: Set up a full simulator mission for a two-pilot crew.
abilities.name: Simulator room setup
skills: Load an airport, aircraft and weather
Reset a station between crews
Run the preflight briefing for a crew

abilities.mission: Use the soldering iron safely and make a joint that holds.
abilities.name: Soldering clearance
skills: Set up the iron, fume extractor and glasses
Tin a wire and join two wires
Make a shiny, cone-shaped joint and inspect it
Shut down and park the iron safely

abilities.mission: Hold altitude and heading, then turn precisely.
abilities.name: Straight-and-level and turns
skills: Hold altitude within 100 ft and heading within 10 degrees
Make 30-degree bank turns to a heading
Use trim to fly hands-off

abilities.mission: Build the tail and connect every control surface with no slop.
abilities.name: Tail and control surfaces
skills: Build the tail and align it square to the wing
Install servos and linkages
Set control throws to the plan

abilities.mission: Take off and land on the centerline in normal conditions.
abilities.name: Takeoff and landing
skills: Rotate at the right speed and climb at best rate
Fly a stabilized approach
Touch down in the landing zone on the centerline
Go around when the approach is not stable

abilities.mission: Move around the airport without a runway incursion.
abilities.name: Taxi and runway safety
skills: Read an airport diagram
Taxi on the centerline at walking speed
Stop at hold-short lines and read back clearances

abilities.mission: Turn a test into data: what you changed, what you measured, what you learned.
abilities.name: Test report
skills: State what you are testing and why
Record at least 3 measured trials
Write one conclusion and the next change

abilities.mission: Decode a METAR and TAF and make a go or no-go decision.
abilities.name: Weather briefing
skills: Decode a METAR for wind, visibility and ceiling
Read a TAF for the next 6 hours
Make and explain a go or no-go call

abilities.mission: Measure lift and drag on your own wing in the academy wind tunnel.
abilities.name: Wind tunnel test
skills: Mount a wing safely in the tunnel
Record readings at 3 angles
Plot the results and explain them
abilities.unlocks: Design work in Aerospace Engineering II

abilities.mission: Build a wing that is straight, strong and the right shape.
abilities.name: Wing build
skills: Build to the plan with no twist
Add a spar and load-test it
Compare two versions with a glide test or the wind tunnel

abilities.mission: Prepare for the FAA private pilot knowledge test.
abilities.name: Knowledge test prep
skills: Finish the online ground school sections
Score 80% or better on 3 practice tests
Review weak areas with an instructor
abilities.unlocks: Readiness to take the knowledge test (from age 15)

courses.build: A robot car that drives a course and finishes one section on its own
courses.name: Intro to Robotics & Coding
courses.notes: Most students reach the robot car capstone in their second semester. Abilities carry over, nothing resets.

weeks.plan: Upload and change the blink sketch, read a button, use a variable and an if statement.
weeks.title: First code

weeks.plan: Wire a distance sensor and print readings. Find a planted fault in a circuit with the meter.

weeks.plan: Meter basics, then the LiPo clearance: check, charge, store, and the smoke procedure.

weeks.plan: Soldering clearance: set up, tin, join, inspect, park the iron.

weeks.plan: Crimp and solder connectors with a pull test. Wire a motor and ESC and calibrate the throttle.

weeks.plan: Bind with a unique phrase, set and test the failsafe. Fastener sizes and threadlocker.

weeks.plan: Model a robot part, print it, check the fit with calipers.

weeks.plan: Chassis to scale in CAD, print, test-fit everything, improve it once and stay under weight.

weeks.plan: Make weight at 1 lb (454 g) or less, figure eight and push test, failsafe test. Write the test report.
weeks.title: Integrate the robot

weeks.title: Arena Pass and tournament

courses.build: A robotic arm that sorts objects on its own
courses.name: Robotic Arm & AI Vision
